Employment Situation News Release Transmission of material in this news release is embargoed until USDL-26-1435 8:30 a.m. (ET) Friday, September 4, 2026 THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION - AUGUST 2026 Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 162,000 in August, and the unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1 percent. The labor force participation rate edged up to 61.6 percent in August. In August, average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 10 cents, or 0.3 percent, to $37.75. The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for June was revised up by 11,000, from +20,000 to +31,000, and the change for July was revised up by 44,000, from -23,000 to +21,000.
